attributes.name: card image variety
attributes.definition: Whether images in galleries, product grids or card sets are distinct per item or one image is repeated across items.

values.definition: One placeholder image is reused across all items in the grid or card set.
Each item has its own distinct image.
Some images repeat while others differ.
Cards or grids have no images.

attributes.name: image caption presence
attributes.definition: Whether images in galleries or grids are accompanied by captions or labels.

values.definition: Images appear without any caption text.
Images have captions or overlaid labels.
No images are present to caption.
